name: Mangadle
summary:
Mangadle is a Wordle-inspired daily guessing game for anime and manga fans. Each day features a new challenge where you identify a character using multi-attribute hints like gender, affiliation, abilities, ranks, and more—refining your guess in up to six tries with intuitive color feedback.

The game covers popular series such as One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Jujutsu Kaisen, and Attack on Titan, with multiple modes ranging from quick to hard to endless practice. Built with modern web tech for fast loading and a smooth mobile experience, Mangadle also supports social sharing to keep your streaks and friendly competition going. Character info is referenced from public sources, with attention to copyright and data hygiene. Whether you’re here to relax or to sharpen your series knowledge, Mangadle makes it engaging and replayable.
